Unlock FPS unlocks the screen, but each game has its own limit. Games tagged 60 MAX stop at 60 FPS whatever you do. Turn on the high frame-rate option inside the game too. Long-press an app for tips or to give it its own rate.
Tip: in App info, turn on Autostart and set Battery saver to No restrictions so HyperOS keeps Unlock FPS running.

HyperOS can close Unlock FPS in the background, and your games drop back to 60. Remove the battery limits to keep it running.

No data for this game yet. If it has a frame-rate setting, pick the highest. If it still feels like 60, the game itself is probably capped.
Unlocks high refresh rates in games on Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO phones. It asks PowerKeeper for the rate you pick, so adaptive refresh and battery life stay untouched everywhere else. No root, no PC.
Turn on Autostart and set Battery saver to No restrictions so HyperOS doesn\'t stop Unlock FPS.

This screen measures frames the system actually delivers to Unlock FPS. Games are limited by their own FPS setting too, so set the in-game frame rate to High/Ultra or 120.

This test screen measured %1$d FPS. A game can only reach %2$d FPS if the game itself supports it. The test does not prove the override took effect inside the game.
The display stayed near %1$dHz even with the %2$dHz override. Tap Re-apply, or report your device.
HyperOS caps many games at 60Hz. Unlock FPS removes that cap only for the games you choose. Everything else keeps adaptive refresh, so battery life stays the same. No root, no PC.
Every game has its own limit

Unlock FPS unlocks the screen, but a game still decides how many frames it draws. Some never go above 60. Others only offer 120 in their own settings, often only on phones the developer has approved. Look for these tags in the app list:
Can go above 60. Turn it on in the game\'s graphics settings.
The game stops at 60. Nothing can make it faster.
HyperOS closes background apps aggressively. Do these steps so Unlock FPS keeps working after you leave the app.
Opens App info. Tap Battery saver and choose No restrictions.
Find Unlock FPS in the list and switch it on.
Target rate, on/off and a one-tap rate switch
Or long-press your home screen, tap Widgets and find Unlock FPS. It shows a preview before you add it.
Long-press your home screen, tap Widgets and find Unlock FPS.
HyperOS blocks adding widgets until Unlock FPS has this permission. Tap Open permissions, find Home screen shortcuts and set it to Allow, then come back and tap Add widget again.
Add it from the home screen instead
Games can\'t go faster than your phone\'s own refresh rate. Open Settings → Display → Refresh rate and choose 120Hz (High).
In Display → Refresh rate, choose 120Hz (High). Games can\'t go faster than this.
First check Settings → Display → Refresh rate is set to 120Hz (High). On 60Hz (Standard) nothing can go higher.
Beast mode: every app runs at the highest rate
Beast mode pushes the system to full performance: every app, system apps included, gets the highest refresh rate (%dHz). Battery use and heat can go up. Use with care.
